appearances.title: Anthropic publishes a subexponential 3-SAT algorithm
appearances.summary: Anthropic published a Lean 4 formalization of a deterministic 2^o(n) algorithm for 3-SAT and for counting solutions. The paper says an internal Claude model found the core algorithm on October 16 with no human input, and that researchers then worked with Claude on the write-up.
